description: Open the tube fin rocket design at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/tube_fin_rocket.ork in OpenRocket. Select the nose cone component from the component tree on the left panel. Double-click it to open its properties. Change the nose cone shape from its current shape to 'Haack series' and set the length to 120mm. Click Close to apply changes. Then save the modified design as /home/ga/Documents/rockets/modified_nosecone_rocket.ork using File > Save As.
